Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
fix: Use runtime CMS_URL instead of build-time NEXT_PUBLIC_CMS_URL

The NEXT_PUBLIC_CMS_URL was not being set during Docker build, causing
the web app to fallback to localhost:3000 when fetching CMS data.

Changed to use runtime environment variables:
- First try CMS_URL if explicitly set
- Fallback to deriving from CMS_GRAPHQL_URL (already configured in ECS)
- Last resort: localhost:3000 for local development

This fixes the 500 error on production: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:3000

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)")
